record_scope_reconstruction: Victoria Falls–Livingstone and Kazungula Botswana–Zimbabwe road posts, for admission of fully vaccinated tourists. The Botswana–Zambia Kazungula bridge is a separate crossing.

source_checks.finding: Minister’s quoted announcement names Victoria Falls and Kazungula and limits reopening to fully vaccinated tourists; goods, returning citizens and foreign departures were outside the general restriction.
Official Botswana Tourism list explicitly separates Kazungula Road under Botswana/Zimbabwe from Kazungula Ferry under Botswana/Zambia.

sites.name: Victoria Falls / Livingstone
sites.coordinate_method: Published AU-PIDA illustrative border-post coordinate, independently read in original report Appendix A
sites.precision: approximate crossing area; illustrative published marker, not surveyed gate
sites.evidence_note: Appendix A, S25, printed page 79; longitude/latitude transcribed in lon,lat order. Report identifies crossing name but does not establish historic operation or exact obstruction.

sites.name: Kazungula Botswana–Zimbabwe road crossing
sites.coordinate_method: Original OSM node coordinate from independently fetched API JSON
sites.precision: approximate crossing facility area; no survey accuracy claimed
sites.evidence_note: Original node explicitly names Zimbabwe entry control. This is the road crossing south of the Zambezi, distinct from Botswana–Zambia ferry and bridge. Inspected OSM tags: {"barrier": "border_control", "name": "Kazungula Border Zimbabwe IN", "opening_hours": "06:00-18:00"}. Geographic evidence only; no historical restriction or current operational status inferred.

Current phase only: Zimbabwe nonessential tourist admission restriction at Victoria Falls and Kazungula, ending only for fully vaccinated tourists

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: Formal onset derives from January 2 immediate land-entry instruction. July 27 approval to July 30 destination-sector report bounds the relaxation; no clock time or independently observed first passenger is established. Only fully vaccinated tourist admission at Victoria Falls and Kazungula is ended; other categories and ports remain outside this endpoint.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
